reason: For a legal input, OneRowPerAbsent fixes the number of new rows. AddsAllAbsent gives each absent starter one row with its id, adapter and model, and the ids are distinct, so no extra or duplicate row can exist. NewInStarterOrder fixes the order, KeepsExisting fixes the old prefix, and the three enabled laws (default off, enable keeps starter, locked off) fix the one remaining field in every case. Every field of every row is therefore determined.
